title: 第十三章 你们都不懂泡妞第十四章 我想蹂躏你
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

read2（）;“吱呀……！”
随着千娇阁顶楼，西厢一扇木门缓缓开启。
两名侍女抬着一张桐木古琴，在廊道木栏，将古琴架好，又铺上青竹凉席和一张蒲团。
随即，在一众宾客的欢呼呐喊中，一道倩影徐徐走出厢房。
阁中的喧嚣声，骤然一寂，而后又轰然沸腾。
“苏大家出来了！”
楼上楼下，无数目光汇聚的焦点。
一袭月白身影浮现。
女子身形修长曼妙，衣袂如流云垂落，腰间素带轻束，衬得身段更显纤袅。
她面上覆着烟紫色的轻纱，只露一双眉眼。
眸若秋水，清冽含光，眼尾微挑，慵懒间透出三分媚意。
青丝半挽，一支白玉簪斜插，余发垂落颈侧，更显肌肤胜雪。
莲步轻移，裙裾微漾间，无声的风情逸散。
妩媚，清纯，还带着一股神秘色彩，瞬间抓住了所有人的眼睛。
尽管还隔着面纱，无法完全看清楚此女的容貌。
仅是那绝美的步态，和完美身材，就令在场宾客的心脏，情不自禁的狠狠抽动。
“好一个尤物！”
便是被千锤百炼的顾尘风，看到此女的一刹，也有片刻的失神。
万众瞩目下，女子款步上前，坐于蒲团之上，轻甩长袖，一根玉指拨动琴弦。

“叮……！”
清脆悠扬的琴音，回荡阁楼。
原本人声鼎沸的千娇阁，竟瞬间变得寂静，落针可闻。
“小女子抚琴一首，献给诸位客官。”
苏大家的声音，亦如琴音般清脆悦耳，绕梁不绝。
阁中众人，如被施展了定身法。
就那么痴痴地望着她的身影，像朝圣的信徒般虔诚。
顾尘风透过窗栏，望向此女，目光也呆滞了一瞬。
下一刻，他却面色一变。
这女人有点邪门！
从对方出现，到拨动那根琴弦。
整个过程，她仿佛接管了千娇阁内，所有人的情绪和心神。
“这是……催眠！”
顾尘风心中微凛。
若非他修炼了开天造化诀，精神力异于常人，对这种手段，有很强的抗性，不然也要遭道。
心中大概猜到了对方的用意。
顾尘风没有出言叫破，反而配合对方表演。
他也故作痴呆地，望向苏大家。
此刻，此女那双秋水眼眸，居高临下，扫视楼阁。
目光在对面，顾尘风和欧阳财所在包厢，多停留了片刻。

随即，袅袅琴音，如朦胧烟雨，浸润四方……
苏大家的琴艺果然高绝，即便以顾尘风这个现代人的眼光，也感到颇为惊艳。
其他人，自是更加如痴如醉。
整个千娇阁都沉浸在，悠扬的琴音之中，气氛和谐。
但顾尘风却敏锐察觉到异常。

read2(); "Squeak...!"
On the top floor of Qianjiao Pavilion, a wooden door in the west wing slowly opened.
Two maids carried a paulownia wood guqin, set it up on the wooden railing of the corridor, and laid out a green bamboo mat and a futon.
Immediately, amidst the cheers and shouts of all the guests, a beautiful figure slowly walked out of the wing.
The noise in the pavilion suddenly fell silent, and then roared to life again.
"Everyone Su is out!"
Upstairs and downstairs, countless eyes gathered.
A moon-white figure emerged.
The woman's figure is slender and graceful, her clothes are hanging down like flowing clouds, and her waist is lightly tied with a plain belt, which makes her figure appear slimmer.
Her face was covered with a smoky purple gauze, only her eyebrows and eyes were exposed.
The eyes are like autumn water, clear and gleaming, the tail of the eyes is slightly raised, and there is a hint of charm in the laziness.
The black hair is half rolled up, with a white jade hairpin inserted sideways, and the remaining hair hangs down the side of the neck, making her skin look better than snow.
The lotus steps move lightly, the skirt of the skirt ripples slightly, and the silent charm escapes.
Charming, pure, and with a mysterious color, it instantly caught everyone's eyes.
Even though she was still separated by a veil, she couldn't fully see her face.
Just her beautiful gait and perfect figure made the hearts of the guests present uncontrollably twitch.
"What a stunner!"
Even Gu Chenfeng, who had been tempered for thousands of times, was stunned for a moment when he saw this woman.
Under the attention of everyone, the woman stepped forward, sat on the futon, flicked her long sleeves, and plucked the strings with a jade finger.
"Ding...!"
The clear and melodious sound of the piano echoed in the attic.
Qianjiao Pavilion, which was originally bustling with people, suddenly became silent, and you could hear a needle drop.
"The little girl plays the zither, and I dedicate it to all our guests."
The voices of the Su family are as clear and sweet as the sound of the piano, and they are endless.
Everyone in the pavilion seemed to have been cast on a body-fixing technique.
He just looked at her figure so longingly, as devoutly as a pilgrim.
Gu Chenfeng looked at the woman through the window bars, and his eyes were dull for a moment.
The next moment, his expression changed.
This woman is a bit evil!
From the moment the other party appears to the moment the string is plucked.
During the whole process, she seemed to take over the emotions and minds of everyone in Qianjiao Pavilion.
"This is... hypnosis!"
Gu Chenfeng felt a little chilled in his heart.
If he hadn't practiced the Art of Creation, his mental strength was different from that of ordinary people, and he would have strong resistance to this method, otherwise he would have suffered.
He probably guessed the other party's intention.
Gu Chenfeng did not speak out, but cooperated with the opponent's performance.
He also pretended to be stupid and looked at the Su family.
At this moment, the woman's autumn eyes were looking down at the pavilion.
Looking at the box opposite Gu Chenfeng and Ouyang Cai, they stayed for a moment longer.
Immediately, the faint sound of the piano penetrated all directions like hazy mist and rain...
The Su family's piano skills are truly superb, even from the perspective of a modern person like Gu Chenfeng, they are quite amazed.
Others are even more intoxicated.
The entire Qianjiao Pavilion was immersed in the melodious music, creating a harmonious atmosphere.
But Gu Chenfeng was keenly aware of the abnormality.
